title: KilometerVision: A New Frontier for Large-Scale Spatial Intelligence in VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.39588v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We push the frontier of large-scale spatial intelligence in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and introduce the first benchmark that probes geographical layout understanding from real-world videos, spanning up to 1km distances. Inspired by the cognitive science literature, we evaluate models against the hierarchical stages of human spatial awareness: anchoring via landmarks, connecting them through routes, and integrating these into global mental maps. Extensive experiments reveal a fundamental divergence in how current AI models process spatial information. Instead of utilising true path integration or forming geometric survey knowledge, we find that VLMs rely almost entirely on 2D visual recognition and text-matching to bypass complex spatial reasoning. The benchmark is publicly available at https://perception-test-challenge.github.io/kilometervision.html.

translated_title: KilometerVision：视觉语言模型（VLM）大规模空间智能的新前沿
translated_abstract: 我们推动了视觉语言模型（VLM）中大规模空间智能的前沿，并引入了首个从真实世界视频中探测地理布局理解能力的基准，空间跨度可达1公里。受认知科学文献的启发，我们根据人类空间感知的层级阶段来评估模型：通过地标进行锚定、通过路线将地标连接起来，并将这些整合为全局心理地图。大量实验揭示了当前AI模型处理空间信息方式上的根本性分歧。我们发现，VLM几乎没有利用真正的路径积分或形成几何测量知识，而是几乎完全依赖2D视觉识别和文本匹配来绕过复杂的空间推理。该基准测试已公开发布于 https://perception-test-challenge.github.io/kilometervision.html。
tldr: 本文提出了首个基于真实世界视频、跨度可达1公里的地理布局理解基准KilometerVision，并揭示当前VLM并非真正进行空间推理，而是几乎完全依赖2D视觉识别和文本匹配来绕过复杂的空间推理。
